# Skill — `node-card`

> Token-cheap read-by-id for ANY system-viz graph node. Returns a node's compact card (label, layer, kind, status, info, + the wiki/memory docs that document it) in ~200 tokens WITHOUT loading the 644MB

**Scope:** user

## Description (first paragraph)

**The problem it solves:** reading a node the old way = `Read` the 644MB `system-graph.json` to extract one record ≈ **~186K tokens**. `node-card` sources the fresh compact index (`system-graph-index.json` → `find-cache.json` fallback) and returns just that node's card ≈ **~200 tokens (98.7% cheaper)**. It NEVER loads the full graph.
